turns.question: How many leads did every 100 euros of social ad spend get us in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no leads-per-spend metric; the closest are Cost per lead (EUR), Leads and Ad spend (EUR): for the social channel from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, cost per lead was 52.5 EUR, from 40 leads on 2100.0 EUR of ad spend. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
